comparator.sourceNotes: The official curriculum describes a three-year bachelor and identifies the major as three quarters of the 180-EC degree, leaving 45 EC of genuine profiling space. The public block schedule lists seven named first-year courses; each occupies one standard 7.5-EC block slot, and a single 7.5-EC first-year programme-space reconciliation component completes the 60-EC year without inventing a subject. For the major choice points, the first-listed year-two elective and first-listed year-three option are selected by official order. The resulting route contains 135 EC of major study and 45 EC of open profiling space; no particular profiling course or minor is assumed.

routeSelection.basis: The target names the generic Educational Sciences bachelor. The full-time programme is the ordinary three-year route. Where the public curriculum presents multiple major options rather than a more general default, the first-listed option is selected independently of UCR fit: Meertalig onderwijs in Nederland in year two and Bachelorstage in year three.

alternatives.label: Learning, development & educational research
alternatives.concept: Combines psychology, lifespan development, social context, qualitative and quantitative methods, policy and evidence synthesis to study how people learn and how educational practice can improve. It is the closest feasible UCR response, although UCR lacks Utrecht's dedicated instructional-design and educational-assessment sequence.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed plan centres behavioural and social accounts of learning, lifespan development and an unusually strong empirical-methods sequence.
progression: The validated UCR sequence places gateways and methods before advanced psychology, sociology, policy and research work; all planned terms are available and nine 300-level courses are included.

alternatives.label: Individual learning, design & technology
alternatives.concept: Develops Utrecht's individual-level learning and educational-design direction through cognition, neuroscience, data science, AI ethics, language and persuasive communication. It supports analysis and responsible design of technology-enhanced learning without claiming UCR offers a specialist instructional-design degree.
alternatives.labelReason: The course set gives sustained weight to cognition, learning mechanisms, AI, data methods and communication as foundations for learning-environment design.
alternatives.distinctness: Relative to the closest plan, this direction replaces the sociology, politics, economics and public-policy spine with neuroscience, cognition, programming, AI, machine learning and language. More than 30 EC changes and the educational question shifts from broad educational improvement to individual learning and technology-supported design.
progression: Mathematics, data, psychology and programming gateways precede advanced AI, cognition and research courses; all prerequisites and offerings pass, with ten 300-level courses.

alternatives.label: Organisational learning, policy & leadership
alternatives.concept: Builds from Utrecht's named organisational-learning, educational-policy and international-system directions, combining organisational psychology, leadership, strategy, entrepreneurship, social research, information systems and persuasive communication for workplace learning and educational change.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed plan joins organisation, policy and leadership courses to research, digital systems, communication and innovation.
alternatives.distinctness: This plan replaces the closest route's psychology, health, politics and economics depth with entrepreneurship, digital transformation, organisational psychology, information systems and strategic communication. It differs from the individual-learning plan by more than 30 EC and centres organisational change and policy rather than cognitive mechanisms.
progression: Business, data, methods and social-science foundations precede advanced organisational psychology, entrepreneurship, communication and computing; all prerequisites and offerings pass, with eight 300-level courses.

selection.assessment: The broad behavioural, social and methods plan is the closest feasible UCR composition. Utrecht's named individual-level learning/design direction and its organisational/policy/international directions also generate two coherent and substantially distinct curricula. All three pass current UCR feasibility checks and differ pairwise by well over 30 EC, so production stops at three.

notes.text: Utrecht's programme is a dedicated Educational Sciences degree with compulsory learning-environment design, educational assessment, organisational learning, applied educational research and a bachelor thesis. UCR can assemble strong behavioural, social, research, technological and organisational foundations, but it does not reproduce that profession-specific sequence or confer the same disciplinary degree identity.
